extra.notes: The point of this example: gameDeclaresUpscalerSupport is false and CSR is still the chosen upscaler. CSR works on a finished frame, so it needs nothing from the engine - unlike FSR 2/3/4 and XeSS, which are unusable here. Set the game itself to 1707x960 (Quality = 1.5x) and CSR scales that to 2560x1440. Frame generation stays off because no external tool can add it.
